ASSORTED SCENTED INCENSE- What is incense made of - Incense Cones are a blend of natural ingredients and fragrances, and used as home fragrance products, which is suitable for home fragrance, Yoga, relaxing. And the burning time of each incense cone is about 5 minutes.

INCENSE GIFT SET-What is incense cones gift set used for - Come with gift box, 8 fragrance to choose from variety pack and 2 holders in a box too. Incense cones may be used whilst practising yoga and meditation, the incense cones smells provide help with relaxation and focus. EASY TO USE- How to light incense sticks or incense cones: In order to release the fragrance of the incense cones, you simply light the cone and place it in a holder to keep it away from surfaces. Blowing out the flame when lit encourages the cones to produce glowing ash-like embers that release the scent. After about 30 seconds, you should be able to smell the incense.
